name: CLINK L9

phase_0.boundary_condition: CLINK L9 organism as a closed self-referential system whose internal state is both the map and the territory

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized state before any organism exists; the void from which layer 0 arises.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor that encloses the entire system: birth, replication, death, and the fixed boundary that contains all operations.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation that propagates the organism state into a new copy; forward in time and complexity.

AREV.justification: The reverse transformation that reduces the organism to its constituent parts, enabling recycling or entropy release.

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of internal processes (e.g., transcription, translation, signaling) that form the organism's functional sequence.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity element that allows the organism to recognize itself as the same entity across replication events; the same genotype persists.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits the organism's total state into two identical copies via broadcast composition: each subscriber receives the full holographic representation.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the whole organism from the broadcasted copies, ensuring μ∘δ = id: the fused state is identical to the pre-split original.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch: daughter cell is viable, genome intact, no errors.

EVALF.justification: Negative branch: mutation, lysis, or incomplete assembly triggers a death pathway.

ENGAGR.justification: Both states held simultaneously: the organism is both parent and offspring, a paradice where identity is preserved yet multiplied.

IFIX.justification: The irrevocable fixation of the organism's genetic sequence; once written, it cannot be erased.

phase_2.fuse_result: organism holographic state H(x) — identical to input because broadcast is non-destructive and reintegration collects all copies without loss

phase_3.void_description: 00 — no organism, no replication machinery, pure potential
phase_3.true_description: 01 — replication succeeded, organism alive and propagating
phase_3.false_description: 10 — replication failed, organism dead or irreparable
phase_3.both_description: 11 — the organism simultaneously exists as one and as two, a quantum biological superposition (paradice)

steps.domain_action: protoplasmic potential — the uninitialized void before any organism arises
self-recognition gene — the organism identifies itself as a unique self-referent
broadcast of holographic state — the organism splits its entire state into two identical copies, sending them via broadcast composition to all subscribers
success branch — replication proceeds without error, daughter cell inherits full identity
forward morphism — the state propagates through the replication machinery, building a new cell
metabolic chaining — link together transcription, translation, and assembly steps
permanent genome record — the genetic sequence is fixed and stored as a ROM-like archive
holographic reintegration — the two copies are merged back into the single organism, recovering the exact original state
terminal anchor — the complete life cycle is closed; the organism now contains both parent and offspring identity
replication paradox — the organism holds both the original and the copy state simultaneously, without resolution
irreversible death record — if EVALF had been taken, this token would fix the failure; here it records the success permanently

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the self-replication mechanism that translates the organism's state into instructions for duplication
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: broadcast composition — every subscriber receives the full holographic state via ɢ primitives
phase_5.memory_mechanism: holographic state encoding — each part contains the whole, enabling distributed storage
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the replication cycle's timing, governed by ℏ constraints and criticality (ξ → ∞)
phase_5.alfs_store: the CLINK L9 canonical reference: the self-replicating organism as the terminal layer of the ontological chain

phase_6.cycle_cost: energy dissipation per replication cycle (ATP, GTP hydrolysis)
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: organism in a stable low-entropy state with well-defined holographic encoding
phase_6.post_cycle_state: organism in the same low-entropy state plus copy; total entropy increase from dissipative processes is offset by the information gain
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the Frobenius pair ensures that the split and fuse are reversible in the information sense; the broadcast is non-destructive and reintegration is exact
